query:
SELECT au.id, au.name, au.email, au.tokenBalance,
       ua.actionType, ua.feature, ua.description, ua.createdAt as actionDate
FROM app_users au
LEFT JOIN user_actions ua ON ua.appUserId = au.id
WHERE au.createdAt >= '2026-03-17'
ORDER BY ua.createdAt DESC;
